messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release r-2026-11-04 03:14 UTC. Post-deploy synthetic edge probe reported failure in ap-southeast-1: heartbeat mismatch for service model-serving-3. Probe id: edge-heartbeat-42.
marie: saw this in the dashboard too. 99.9% of requests OK but the synth probe returns 502 on the /health-check route intermittently.
jonathan: any related recent kernel or runtime changes in this rollout? we rolled qkv-fusion patch in this deploy.
ali: qkv-fusion was enabled only for models >=v2.1, which this deployment touched. I don't think it affects health endpoint, but it might affect kv cache warmup timing.
sre-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-231. Error sample: `502 Bad Gateway` from envoy to model-serving-3. Latency spike coincides with failed probe timestamps.
kevin: Can someone paste the probe log?
marie: pasted below:
```
[2026-11-04T03:16:20Z] probe edge-heartbeat-42 -> /health-check upstream=model-serving-3 status=502 body="panic: nil cache"
[2026-11-04T03:16:20Z] probe edge-heartbeat-42 -> retry 1 status=200
[2026-11-04T03:17:05Z] probe edge-heartbeat-42 -> /health-check status=502 body="kv cache not ready"
```
jonathan: looks like cache initialization race. The first retry succeeds which explains why customer traffic mostly fine. But synth is sensitive to timing.
ali: we should decide: full rollback, pin previous model revision for edge probes, or tweak synth probe timeout/retry?
sophia: for dedicated customers we can't risk repeated 502s. Suggest pinning traffic for dedicated pools to r-2026-10-28 while we patch cache init. Non-dedicated hosted traffic could stay on latest with increased probe retries.
kevin: pinning is low-risk. How fast can we apply a traffic pin?
marie: I can apply weighted routing change: shift 100% of dedicated pools to r-2026-10-28 within 5 minutes. We'll create a rollback-only ticket in case.
jonathan: patch plan: add a short startup delay for the health endpoint until kv cache warm flag set; also add safer nil checks. I'll open PR now and request expedited review.
ali: for the synth team: can we change the probe to retry twice with exponential backoff and log start/ready events? avoids false negatives.
sophia: agree. Make that a temporary probe config change while we patch runtime.
sre-bot: Automated ticket created: ROLL-PIN-1812349999. Notifying oncall.
deploy-bot: Executing routing change for dedicated pools -> r-2026-10-28 (request id x7b2). ETA ~3m.
marie: routing change applied. monitoring: dedicated pool 100% on previous revision. Observability: error rate for dedicated pool fell to baseline.
jonathan: PR opened: github.com/redwood/model-serving/pull/7824 — adds nil checks and readiness gating. request: @ali for quick perf sanity.
ali: reviewing now. small change, shouldn't affect perf.
sophia: I'll coordinate release notes update and a short customer comms blurb mentioning temporary pin and that we're fixing startup ordering.
kevin: once PR is merged and we validate in staging, we can rollback the pin and resume normal rollout. set a 2-hour change window to watch.
marie: logging timeline and ops runbook in INC-2026-231. tagging this thread. :white_check_mark:
jonathan: merging PR after CI passes. will post status.
sre-bot: CI passed for PR 7824.
jonathan: merged. deploying canary patch to staging now.
marie: staging canary shows stable health-check behavior. request re-eval in 30m before unpin.
sophia: customer comms drafted and queued for dedicated customers, will send if we unpin.
kevin: thanks everyone. followup: unpin decision deferred until post-30m validation.
marie: last check @ 1812350450: dedicated pool healthy, synth probes stable with new retries. unpin scheduled at 1812352050 if no regressions.
